name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
known_limitations: The KEV catalog identifies known exploited vulnerabilities for prioritization, but local risk still depends on affected assets, exposure, mitigations, patch status, and operational context.
jurisdiction: United States federal and global cybersecurity
automation_notes: Poll JSON feed for newly added KEV entries, due dates, vendor products, and required actions.
notes: Priority operational cybersecurity source. Phase 48 signal uses the catalog as an operational watch rail; run a direct JSON feed pull before making count-based or latest-entry claims.
